images.alt: The Milky Way with the dark Coalsack Nebula beside the stars of the Southern Cross
images.caption: The Southern Cross and the dark Coalsack beside it in the Milky Way, the head of the Emu in the Sky that many Aboriginal peoples see in the dark lanes. Photograph by ESO/Y. Beletsky, licence CC BY 4.0, cropped to the sky.
images.credit: Photograph: ESO / Y. Beletsky, via Wikimedia Commons (cropped)
